Our students and staff have the opportunity to travel to partner universities and companies in various parts of Europe. We cooperate with Universities in Granada (Spain), Girona (Spain), Zadar (Croatia), Debrecen (Hungary), and Nicosia (Cyprus). Additionally, the іnstitute cooperates with internship organizers – Jobtrust, Animafest, Blue Lagoon Group, Polish Culture House in Lithuania, H-Top Hotels & Resorts Group in Spain.
